rationale: The offering is explicitly described as no-code automation software that turns high-volume workload into streamlined workflows. This is a meaningful conventional workflow-automation function; the text does not require assuming a particular deterministic implementation.
evidence_spans: No-code automation software to transform high-volume workload into streamlined workflows
conflict_response: The concern correctly rejects treating 'no-code' as proof of deterministic implementation. However, the description does state the function—automation of workload into workflows—and routine workflow automation is conventional absent an affirmative AI signal or a specific AI-dependent capability. This supports non-AI without inferring rules.
